Location: The Netherlands | Full-time | Open to candidates currently based in Spain Are you experienced in Revit or BIM and interested in moving your career into the high-voltage and energy infrastructure sector? As an Electrical BIM Modeler, you will work on the design and development of high-voltage substations in the Netherlands. You will translate electrical engineering input into accurate 3D models and technical drawings, working closely with Primary and Secondary Engineers, Civil Engineers and other BIM specialists. You will work on both new substations and extensions or modifications of existing installations. What will you do?
